proof-narrative-lean-equiv.evidence: Ref (library `QOU/Archimedean/shell_structure_eigenvalues.lean:105`) proves only Vieta + Binet recurrence for hypothesised roots λ±; never encodes V̂(n), z or initial data. Sibling `.lean` differs from the library and defines `shellVolume 1 = h/(q^½+q^−½)+1`, i.e. convention C z, against the statement's convention D z = q³/(q²+1) (md:116). Shell energies only via `BorromeanQuark` class field `energy_law`. Narrative: stated V̂(0,q)=1 (md:157) is false for the defined V̂ = z(Tⁿ)₁₁+(Tⁿ)₂₁: V̂(0)=z=q³/(q²+1) (sympy). "(Tⁿ)₂₁ = U_{n−1}((q−q⁻¹)/2)" (md:100) is false: n=3 gives (T³)₂₁ − U₂(h/2) = 2 (these are Fibonacci polynomials, U at ih/2 up to iⁿ); library Lean docstring :58 repeats it. Proof (prf:1-2) proves the recurrence for (Tⁿ)₂₁ only (correct; "det T=−1" is not what gives (Tⁿ)₂₂=(Tⁿ⁻¹)₂₁, T₂₂=0 is). Proof then carries Rydberg/hydrogen claims: "ε = 0.1073" (prf:38) is the stale wrong value the authorNote says was corrected (λ₊−1 = 0.109979); "reproduces the Rydberg formula to the precision of low-n hydrogen spectroscopy" (prf:57) is an empirical claim, and e^{−nε} ≈ 1/n² is unproved. No q-range: | λ₊ | >1> | λ₋ | (md:133) needs q>1
